title: Web3Forum
tagline: A chat forum for the decentralised web, built on the Polygon network.
description: This project combines a browser-based frontend to allow users to post messages on a forum. It is designed like various chat forums we are used to on various web2 platforms/websites but this is a decentralized version. This project uses the ethers to connect the solidity smart contract to the front-end app (Chakra-UI). Hardat was used to spin up the backend (contracts).  It is deployed on the Polygon network.
